scripts.test:browser: npm run test:browser:public && npm run test:browser:enabled
scripts.test:browser:public: VITE_PUBLIC_EVALUATIONS_ENABLED=false npm run build && node tests/public-preview.mjs
scripts.test:browser:enabled: VITE_PUBLIC_EVALUATIONS_ENABLED=true npm run build && node tests/browser-accessibility.mjs
scripts.test:full-flow: npm --prefix ../api-gateway run build && VITE_PUBLIC_EVALUATIONS_ENABLED=true VITE_API_BASE=http://127.0.0.1:8081 npm run build && node tests/full-flow.mjs
